description: Mycelium webview permissions. The window loads the local Node server (http://127.0.0.1:8787) as a REMOTE origin, so window IPC (notably start-dragging, used to make the header a window-drag strip) must be granted to that origin explicitly — without this, Tauri v2 denies the IPC by default and the drag does nothing. The two opener grants (D-010) let the browser sign-in URL open in the OS default browser: allow-open-url grants the open_url command, allow-default-urls supplies its scope for http/https/mailto/tel only (no file-path opening, no reveal-in-dir). The five unprefixed allow-* grants (D-022) are the app's OWN commands: a remote origin is refused EVERY custom command ("Command <cmd> not allowed by ACL") unless named here, which is why "Check for updates" failed on v0.1.13. They are autogenerated from the command list in build.rs (permissions/autogenerated/*.toml) and this list is exactly the set the portal invokes — no wildcard, no unused grant, and the updater/process/dialog plugins get NO webview permission because they are driven from Rust only.
